The `sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` fixture is the official OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 JSON
schema from https://github.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/tree/main/sarif-2.1/schema.
The OASIS Open Repository schema is provided under the terms in the repository
LICENSE.md. It is vendored at the 2.1.0 schema path so CI validates offline.
